title: PurrSwap (Abracadabra) — Factory oracle validation / stale _I_ (Guardian C-06, C-07, H-02, M-06)
closed_reasons: No live victim funds: the only 2 PurrSwap pools hold dust (~$0 and ~$0.078)
Factory.create is permissionless by design (Guardian M-03 acknowledged); C-06/C-07 harm is opt-in to a pool the attacker themselves creates/seeds
No protocol-owned liquidity and no router that forces users into attacker-created pools
Pool 1 was never seeded by a real LP (totalSupply == 1001 dead shares)
Pool 2's sole LP is a self-service holder (H-O), not an external victim
key_facts: HyperEVM chainid 999; Factory 0x802762e604CE08a79DA2BA809281D727A690Fa0d (owner = Abracadabra safe 0xfB3485c2e209A5cfBDC1447674256578f1A80eE3); PurrLP impl 0x76DA31D7C9CbEAE102aff34D3398bC450c8374c1
Factory.create(base,quote,lpFeeRate,i,k,oracle) has NO oracle validation (no whitelist, no require) — fork-proven: attacker created pools with a mock oracle and with a bare EOA oracle
Global LogCreated scan == exactly 2 pools: 0x4E90767E92E58170F6732a7Fa652e03B82e5bb44 (WHYPE/KEI) and 0x7B3959da5d74648Af48B8D69e19ea6a9812cdFDB (wstHYPE/WHYPE)

Pool 2 frozen i=1.0 vs market i~1.02635 (DefiLlama) -> ~2.64% permanent mispricing; querySellBase(1e12) frozen 1000375559624 vs market 1026738686015

Pool 1 USD ~$0 (639 wei WHYPE + 20535 wei KEI; only 1001 dead shares); pool 2 USD ~$0.0782 (2.0589e-4 wstHYPE + 7.8447e-4 WHYPE), held by EOA 0x1453Acb73B4c13BCE00496Ae00DdC7E4cF484C6c who can self-withdraw it
Separate Abracadabra MIMSwap/MagicLP factory 0xc8f5eb8a632f9600d1c7bc91e97dad5f8b1e3748 (impl 0xD6b8bd85A9593cb47c8C15C95bbF3e593c5Dc591) is a distinct product, empty, not counted
caveats: KEI is unpriced; pool 1 uses a generous $1/KEI upper bound and is still < $1e-12
Values are a snapshot at block 49,292,001 (2026-10-23); USD moves only with HYPE price
PoC is fork-only (no mainnet transactions); run against the keyless public HyperEVM RPC
Latent risk: any future real-liquidity pool created with oracle=0 is permanently mispriced and arbitrageable at the full market/frozen deviation
one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract ~$0 live from PurrSwap on HyperEVM: the C-06 (no oracle validation) and H-02/M-06 (stale frozen _I_) mechanisms are live and fork-proven, but the only 2 pools hold dust (~$0.078 total, holder-only recoverable) and pool creation harm is opt-in, so E-U = $0.
